profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | AI Agentic Engineer
profile.summary: Professional software engineer with a proven track record in developing solutions and commercial software architectures which increase the efficiency of business processes. Over eight years hands-on experience architecting technical projects, developing, implementing, testing and maintaining systems for clients. Combine solid knowledge of process and technology with a proven ability to complete high quality works with high customer satisfaction and appreciation. Proficient with IT industry software including: MS Visual Studio, MS SharePoint Design and Development and WSS, Adobe Dreamweaver, MSSQL Server, MS Access and any relational database solutions using PL/SQL scripts, t-SQL stored procedures, functions, views and indexing. Possesses extensive experience with OS such as Linux and Windows.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Implements complex internet and intranet applications on one or more platforms. Acts as an escalation point for production troubleshooting guidance; provides training and mentoring to less experienced developers. May perform website and portal monitoring. Uses knowledge of web technologies to lead projects resulting in functional enhancements of web-based applications. Evaluates systems specifications for client web site requirements, leads design presentations, influences direction and implements the most efficient and cost-effective software/package solution. Coordinates with systems partners outside the group and oversees contractors on projects. Performs web-enabled database development and module design. Uses programming tools to write scripts. Performs web security activities and participates in security planning.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Develop, design and support software technologies for the Wholesale Financing Division within the bank. Analyzes business requirements, designs and writes technical specifications to design or redesign computer solutions.  Develops original and/or complex code or provides coding guidance to less experienced staff. Leads and/or performs modeling, simulations and analysis efforts. Verifies program logic by overseeing the preparation of test data, testing and debugging of programs. Participates in overall systems testing. Leads the migration of applications to production. Develops new documentation, participates in the development of department technical procedures and designs user guides. As an escalation point for application support and troubleshooting, provides guidance and direction to less experienced staff in resolution of escalated issues and/or complex production, application or system problems. Leads projects, including assignment of tasks, and provides direction and guidance to less experienced staff. Assures quality, security and compliance requirements are met for supported area and oversees updating and testing of the business continuation plan.

positions.title: Software Engineer and Client Services Specialist
positions.description:
- Intensive .NET development in web environments.
- Develop applications and solutions based on client/customer requirements. 
- MS SQL Server database designer.
- Support all steps of software development life cycle.
- Keep a clear and explicit documentation.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: BLI Messaging is a national leader in electronic messaging automation and enterprise CRM software provider. Email, Voice, Fax, and SMS. My roles and responsibilities were to move a list of more than 40 client’s websites (IIS + .NET Applications) and over 50 DBs (SQL2000 to SQL2005) to Virtual Machine Servers. My software engineering experience guaranteed the integrity and quality of these DBs and Websites during and post migration.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Employed by Lamparth Consulting
	Senior Software Engineer and Database Administrator.
Multinational fiber optics and glass manufacturing industry with 125 years on market. 
Software and solutions developer for a wide range of production and management environments.
- Self directing and leading all software development and implementation for this and other facilities.
- Database Administrator/Developer for: Production, Document Control, Management, Time and Attendance and Payroll Systems.
- Parts Inspections System Developer: Application for QA, inspect and ship glass parts.
- Main Production Database Administrator. Front-End Application enhanced and improved. Back-end database performed. 
- High complexity queries and reports creation to track and monitor production.
- Intranet Portal and Documents Versioning and Control System development based on Microsoft SharePoint and Lotus Notes.
- IT Request System upgrade based on ITIL (Information Technology Infrastructure Library)
	- Microsoft Visual Studio 2005 / 2008 Based Development. (.NET Technologies, VB6, VB.Net and C#)
- GFanuc Real Time Information Portal Administrator.	- Database data transferring, conversion and upgrading.		
- Recurrent meetings and planning driving.		- Framework 3.0 based programming. 
	- SQL Server 2000/2005 and Microsoft Access DB	- Crystal Reports Creations and Support.

positions.title: Applications Analyst and Developer
positions.description:
Time and attendance and Payroll systems based on biometrics Technologies Understandings. Agile Software Development.
Significant achievements performing the DB design. New Payroll Interfaces Created. Lange list of solved issues and new features.
- Systems Development Life Cycle. 			- IIS and Virtual Directory Configuration.
	- Visual Basic 6, VB.NET and C#.Net Environments.	- Framework 1.0 and 2.0
	- SQL Server and Microsoft Access DB		- Crystal Reports 8.5 and 9.0
	- Microsoft Visual Source Safe Code Management.	- SharePoint Intranet Portal support and development.

positions.title: Enterprise Systems Analyst/Developer. Database administrator and designer
positions.description:
- Technical lead on software engineering projects, intranet services, VoIP telephony, operative systems and networks applications.
- Project manager for business intelligence applications.	- MS SharePoint Server + Application Templates setup for 5 clients.
- Hardware and operative systems performer.		- Senior Consultant and Manager for SharePoint upgrades, tier-3 support.
- Software support and helpdesk.			- Rapid applications developer and fast data restoring.
